entities.name: Saint Olav's Church, Kirkjubøur
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Saint Olav's Church is a medieval church in the village of Kirkjubøur in Streymoy, Faroe Islands. It was built before 1200, which makes it the oldest church of the Faroe Islands. Until the Reformation, it served as the seat of the Catholic bishop of the Faroe Islands.
